test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Finance Minister launched Nari Shakti branches of which bank to empower women entrepreneurs in November 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Union Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Finance Minister** launched the **Nari Shakti** branches of **Union Bank** to empower **women entrepreneurs** in November 2024.
 
• The initiative aims to provide **financial services** and support to **women-led businesses**.
 
• These branches are designed to cater specifically to the needs of **women entrepreneurs**, offering tailored **financial products** and **services**.
 
• The launch of these branches is part of a broader effort to **encourage and support** women in the business sector.
 
• Union Bank of India is one of the largest government-owned banks in India, with a significant focus on **inclusive banking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **HDFC Bank**__

 __
 
• **HDFC Bank** is one of India's leading private sector banks.
 
• It is known for its extensive range of **financial products** and **services**.
 
• While it supports various initiatives, the Nari Shakti branches were not launched under this bank.
 
 
 
• **PNB**__
 __
 
• **Punjab National Bank (PNB)** is one of the oldest and largest government-owned banks in India.
 
• It offers a wide range of **banking services** but was not the bank associated with the Nari Shakti initiative.
 
 
 
• **SBI**__
 
 
• **State Bank of India (SBI)** is the largest bank in India and a public sector banking and financial services company.
 
• Although SBI has numerous initiatives for women, the specific Nari Shakti branches were not launched by this bank.
